meta.title: 1938 California Bungalow Living Room, Cozy Redesign
meta.task: Photorealistic interior rendering, three views of the same living room, consistent finishes and furniture across all views. Cozy, lived-in redesign using mostly existing furniture. Walls, doorways, windows, and fireplace are unchanged.
meta.consistency_rule: Every view shows the same room, objects, materials, colors and light. Any object in more than one view must match exactly in shape, size, color and placement.

style.finish: no CGI sheen, subtle film grain, natural lens falloff, true-to-life material texture

interior_render.design_concept: A 1938 California bungalow living room styled for comfort. Three zones along its length: credenza bar at the south end, fireplace conversation group in the middle around a large blue velvet couch, and a reading library with bookshelf built-ins at the north end.

room.ceiling: Flat white plaster, simple original crown molding, existing recessed cans dimmed to about 20 percent, warm 2700K, barely visible
room.trim: Original 1930s window and door casings and baseboards in Benjamin Moore Ivory White, satin
room.floor: Natural white oak hardwood, matte, with the original dark walnut inlay border running around the room perimeter, visible outside the rug on all sides

arch_west_wall.fireplace: Centered on the west wall, unchanged. Vertical white oak slat surround from floor up to a white oak floating mantel shelf; slats stop at the shelf, plain painted wall above. Handmade ivory tile with slight glaze variation around the firebox. Ivory quartz slab hearth.
arch_west_wall.window_south: One single double-hung window south of the fireplace, ivory casing, natural woven wood roman shade raised partway
arch_west_wall.window_north: One connected double window north of the fireplace, ivory casing, natural woven wood roman shades raised partway

arch_north_wall.window: Connected double window centered on the wall, woven wood shade, floor-to-ceiling natural linen drapery panels on a slim bronze rod mounted at the crown, stacked off the glass
arch_north_wall.bookshelves: One tall built-in style light oak bookshelf unit on each side of the window: flat-panel closed cabinet doors on the bottom third, open shelves above, simple oak toe-kick base, oak trim board across the top meeting the window casing so both units read as one built-in wall
arch_north_wall.shelf_light: Warm LED strip under one upper shelf on each unit, lit

architecture.arch_east_wall: Long solid wall, no windows, one cased doorway at the far south end

arch_south_wall.foyer_arch: Small arched opening to the foyer on the west side
arch_south_wall.bar_zone: East side holds the credenza bar

f_couch.description: Very large deep blue velvet sofa, 108 in wide, rolled arms, plain untufted cushions, low walnut legs
f_couch.placement: Centered on the east wall, facing the fireplace

f_lounge_chairs.description: Pair of matching mid-century lounge chairs, exposed walnut frames, seats and backs upholstered in rust wool
f_lounge_chairs.placement: One on each side of the fireplace, turned 45 degrees toward the couch, leaving the slat surround fully visible between them

f_coffee_table.description: Oval walnut mid-century coffee table, about 54 in long, lower shelf
f_coffee_table.placement: Centered between the couch and the lounge chairs, long axis north-south

f_ottoman.description: Low rectangular upholstered ottoman, olive green boucle, 36 x 24 in
f_ottoman.placement: Near the hearth between the two lounge chairs, used as a footrest; low enough that the hearth and lower slats still read

f_side_tables.description: Small round walnut side table at each end of the couch, each holding a ceramic table lamp; a small walnut stool beside the south lounge chair
f_side_tables.placement: Flanking the couch arms; stool beside the south lounge chair

f_reading_chair.description: Single upholstered armchair in oatmeal linen with a sheepskin draped over the back
f_reading_chair.placement: In front of the north window between the two bookshelf units, angled toward the fireplace; tall aged brass floor lamp behind it; small round walnut side table beside it

f_credenza_bar.description: Existing walnut mid-century credenza used as a bar, topped with a turntable, a small brass dome lamp, eight bottles with glassware, and a medium plant in a matte black pot
f_credenza_bar.placement: East side of the south wall

f_rug.description: Vintage-style Turkish wool rug, 10 x 14 ft, warm oatmeal ground, faded rust and indigo pattern, low pile, no fringe
f_rug.placement: Long side running north-south under the conversation group, inside the walnut inlay border with oak floor visible all around it

f_floor_vessel.description: Large unglazed ceramic floor vessel holding tall dried branches
f_floor_vessel.placement: Beside the foyer arch, inside the room

art.art_east_wall: One large framed abstract landscape on canvas, 66 in wide x 44 in tall, muted indigo, rust, ochre and cream, simple dark walnut floater frame, centered over the couch with its bottom edge 9 in above the sofa back
art.art_mantel: Wide framed sepia landscape photograph of rolling California hills, 44 in wide, light oak frame, centered above the mantel shelf, lit by the picture light
art.art_bar_wall: One vintage cocktail chart print in a dark walnut frame above the credenza; nothing else on that wall
art.art_mantel_shelf: One small ceramic vessel and a short stack of three books, placed off center
art.art_shelves: Real reader's shelves: books with jackets off in warm muted tones filling about two thirds of each shelf, a few pieces of pottery, two framed family photographs, one small plant, a wooden bowl

plants.p_ficus: Tall Ficus Audrey in a large terracotta pot in the northwest corner beside the west bookshelf unit; canopy just below the crown molding (about 8 ft overall)
plants.p_bar_plant: Medium plant in a matte black pot on the credenza bar
plants.p_pothos: Small pothos trailing from an upper bookshelf
plants.p_branches: Tall dried branches in the floor vessel by the foyer arch

accessories.acc_couch_pillows: Four pillows on the blue couch: one rust velvet, one olive linen, one cream and rust stripe, one small oatmeal textured
accessories.acc_chair_pillows: One cream pillow on each lounge chair
accessories.acc_throws: Chunky oatmeal wool throw draped loosely over the north arm of the couch; sheepskin over the back of the reading chair
accessories.acc_hearth: Blackened steel fireplace tool set beside the hearth; split oak firewood in a leather carrier
accessories.acc_coffee_table: Stack of two books, dark ceramic bowl, small brass tray, lit candle in a low holder
accessories.acc_reading_nook: Open book and a mug on the side table beside the reading chair

lighting.time_of_day: Early evening, last of the daylight through the north and west windows, soft and cool against warm interior light
lighting.picture_light: Slim aged brass plug-in picture light above the mantel art, cord hidden, warm glow on the photograph
lighting.lamps: Ceramic table lamps with linen shades at both ends of the couch, tall aged brass floor lamp behind the reading chair, brass dome lamp on the credenza; all lit warm
lighting.shelf_lighting: Warm LED strip under one upper shelf on each bookshelf unit, lit
lighting.fire: Full fire burning in the firebox, warm flicker on hearth, tile and nearby surfaces
lighting.cans: Recessed cans at about 20 percent, 2700K, barely on
lighting.mood: Pools of warm lamplight with soft shadow between them; the room glows warm and inviting

color_palette.accent_rule: Accents repeat across the rug, pillows, lounge chair upholstery, ottoman and art

metals.aged_brass: all lamps and the picture light

camera.position: At the east wall on the couch centerline, lens just above the sofa back
camera.direction: Looking west over the back of the blue couch at the fireplace

composition.foreground: Top of the blue velvet sofa back and pillows along the bottom edge
composition.midground: Coffee table with styling, rug, olive ottoman by the hearth, rust lounge chairs at 45 degrees on either side of the fireplace, walnut stool beside the left chair
composition.background: Fireplace with oak slat surround, ivory tile, quartz hearth and fire; mantel shelf styling; sepia photograph lit by the brass picture light; single window on the left (south) and double window on the right (north) with woven shades and evening light
composition.edges: Hint of the foyer arch at far left, hint of the north bookshelf and Ficus at far right

views.name: View B, toward the south wall

camera.position: At the north window beside the reading chair
camera.direction: Looking south down the length of the room

composition.left_east: Blue couch with pillows and oatmeal throw, couch lamps, large abstract painting above; east doorway at the far end
composition.ahead_south: Credenza bar on the left side of the far wall with turntable, brass dome lamp, bottles, glassware and black-potted plant, cocktail chart print above; floor vessel with dried branches beside the foyer arch on the right side of the far wall
composition.right_west: Double window, fireplace with slat surround, fire, mantel photograph and picture light, lounge chairs and ottoman, then the single window
composition.center: Rug, coffee table, walnut inlay border along the floor edges

camera.direction: Looking north down the length of the room

composition.left_west: Single window, fireplace with fire, slat surround, mantel photograph and picture light, lounge chairs and ottoman, double window
composition.right_east: Blue couch with pillows and throw, couch lamps, large abstract painting above
composition.center: Rug, coffee table, walnut inlay border
composition.far_end_north: Library wall: two light oak bookshelf units with LED strips glowing, flanking the double window with linen drapery; oatmeal reading chair with sheepskin, brass floor lamp lit behind it, side table with open book and mug; Ficus Audrey in terracotta in the northwest (left) corner; pothos trailing from an upper shelf

negative_prompt: changed walls, doorways, windows or fireplace
